articles.title: Hackers Actively Exploiting WordPress Remote Code Execution Flaw Just Hours After Patch Release
articles.summary:
A WordPress remote code execution vulnerability came under attack just hours after version 7.1.4 was released on October 28, 2026, fixing 22 vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated code execution flaw in the update process. Site owners should verify that the patch is installed. According to Wordfence’s supplied threat report, its firewall recorded more than 18,500 requests […]
